summary: Tested centralized SOLUTIONS data refactor. Solutions listing page (/solutions) displays all 11 solution cards correctly with icons, titles, descriptions, and tags. Solution detail pages load with full content (tagline, description, applications, benefits). Navigation between pages works correctly. Fixed minor bug in SolutionDetail.js icon handling.

features_tested.feature: Solutions listing page at /solutions loads correctly with all 11 solution cards
features_tested.details: All 11 solutions (retail, corporate, outdoor, events, creative, traffic, immersive, transparent, healthcare, education, sports) display correctly in grid layout

features_tested.feature: Each solution card displays icon, title, description, and tags correctly
features_tested.details: Icons rendered using lucide-react components, titles/descriptions from centralized data, tags (e.g., 'Shopfronts', 'Video Walls') display correctly

features_tested.feature: Solution detail page at /solutions/retail loads with full content
features_tested.details: Hero section with title, tagline, description, icon. Overview section with longDescription. Applications (8 items) and Benefits (6 items) sections render correctly.

features_tested.feature: Solution detail page at /solutions/corporate loads correctly
features_tested.details: All content renders correctly. Previous/Next navigation shows 'Retail & Hospitality' and 'Outdoor Advertising & DOOH'

features_tested.feature: Solution detail page at /solutions/healthcare loads correctly
features_tested.details: Healthcare-specific content displays: tagline 'Mission-critical displays for patient care', applications include Hospital lobbies, Nurse station dashboards, etc.

features_tested.feature: Navigation to solution detail pages works from solution cards
features_tested.details: Clicking solution card navigates to correct detail page. Back link returns to /solutions listing.

features_tested.feature: Icons display correctly on both listing and detail pages
features_tested.details: Icons display correctly after fix. Solutions.js and SolutionDetail.js both render icons from centralized data.

critical_code_review_comments: Centralized data file /data/solutions.js correctly exports SOLUTIONS array with all required fields
FIXED: SolutionDetail.js line 128 was using ICON_MAP[solution.icon] which doesn't work since solution.icon is a component. Changed to: const Icon = solution.icon || Building2
Solutions.js correctly uses solution.icon directly as component
Both files maintain separate SOLUTION_IMAGES objects - this is intentional as they use different image sets (card images vs hero images)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Centralized SOLUTIONS data successfully implemented at /data/solutions.js. Solutions.js and SolutionDetail.js import from centralized file. Icons stored as component functions (e.g., icon: ShoppingBag). Minor fix applied to SolutionDetail.js to use solution.icon directly instead of ICON_MAP lookup.
